context_description: DNA damage response and repair in hereditary breast and ovarian cancer. Focus on homologous recombination pathway defects and their implications for cancer susceptibility, therapeutic response, and synthetic lethality approaches.

schema_example.description: High-fidelity repair of DNA double-strand breaks through homologous recombination pathway
schema_example.evidence_summary: Extensive biochemical and genetic evidence demonstrates critical roles in HR repair. Loss of function leads to genomic instability and cancer predisposition
